patch.summary: Seamless.AI cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Seamless.AI pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Seamless.AI cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Seamless.AI against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Pro and Enterprise list prices are often quote-led rather than fully self-serve published dollars. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when SMB and mid-market SDR teams that need high-volume email/phone contact data requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Data accuracy still requires buyer verification workflows — not a lab-audited guarantee

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Free plan limits make serious outbound volume a paid conversation quickly

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a full CRM system of record

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Chrome/LinkedIn prospecting workflows carry platform compliance risk some orgs reject
